svg.aria-label: Current open embedders beside bge-small · nDCG@10
svg.text: Current open embedders beside bge-small · nDCG@10
nDCG@10 with 95% bootstrap intervals over the queries (whiskers). The tag on a new model's row is its paired interval
against the bge row it replaces: above or below zero, or a tie when it covers zero; every row is kept, losers included.
The app's default is bge-small with bge-reranker-v2-m3 (marked app's default); the larger models are measured here for the benchmark tables.
make figures, from fixture v1: results sha 5e7638a (harrier 9f1da07), BEIR SciFact: results sha 23729b3 (harrier 9f1da07), BEIR FiQA: results sha 23729b3 (harrier 9f1da07).
